raw_segments.text: She turned and disappeared behind the portier so quickly that Alyosha had not time to utter a word, though
he wanted to speak. He longed to beg her pardon, to blame himself, to say something, for his heart was full,
and he could not bear to go out of the room without it.
But Madame Holikov took him by the hand and drew him along with her. In the hall, she stopped him again as before.
